name: Timesheet Setup - Create Dated Folder & Files

parameters.functionCode:
const data = $input.first().json;
return {json: {status: 'success', message: 'Timesheet setup completed', details: {timesheetDate: data.timesheetDate, folderName: data.formattedDate, outputPath: data.outputPath, filesCreated: ['RossNanton-Invoice-' + data.formattedDate + '.docx', 'RossNanton-Timesheet-' + data.formattedDate + '.xlsx']}}}};
